news.headline: USC's Eric Gentry to redshirt after 'series of concussions'
news.description: USC linebacker Eric Gentry, who was leading the team in tackles and sacks through the first four games, will redshirt the rest of the 2024 season after suffering "a series of concussions in a short period of time."

news.headline: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas out for season
news.description: USC defensive end Anthony Lucas will miss the rest of the season due to a "lower extremity" injury, head coach Lincoln Riley announced Tuesday.

news.headline: Singled out in NFL officiating video, Bears' Simmons draws false-start ire from Lions
news.description: Bears DT Jeffery Simmons was the subject of controversy during Chicago's win at Detroit on Thanksgiving Day.

news.headline: Steelers, fueled by jabs over Aaron Rodgers drama, 'come together' to rout Broncos
news.description: Turned into a national punchline following Aaron Rodgers' release, the Steelers played with a sense of "urgency" and "anger" Friday night in a 27-5 win over Denver.

news.headline: Bo Nix, after one of his worst games for Broncos, says 'I let the team down'
news.description: After one of the most difficult starts of his NFL career, Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said "I let the team down'' in a 27-5 loss to the Steelers on Friday.

news.headline: Sam Darnold 'ready to roll' vs. 49ers as Seahawks fight to stay in NFC West race
news.description: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold, who missed the past two games with a quad injury, will return to start against the Niners in a pivotal NFC West showdown.

news.headline: DJ Uiagalelei to start for Chargers with Justin Herbert in concussion protocol
news.description: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert was ruled out for Sunday as he remains in concussion protocol, coach Jim Harbaugh said Friday, meaning DJ Uiagalelei will start against Tommy DeVito and the Patriots.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts.
